notes: This contract pins the bounded IEEE 1516.2-2025 FOM composition checks for data-type representation references and the two standard object-instance identifier references. The preflight rejects unresolved simple/enumerated representations, rejects basic-data or reference-data representations in an ordinary reference data type, and applies the reviewed special-instance-identifier exception with the standardized HLAunicodeString/HLAobjectInstanceHandle representations. The simple/enumerated source wording is reconciled with the official MIM/Restaurant DIF example by requiring resolution while permitting the example's declared non-basic HLAboolean representation; RL-009 records that interpretation. This is private source/test traceability only, not a FOM conformance or public-service evidence claim.
